name: slashpcb
description: Local PCB workbench: Claude and Codex review and work on KiCad schematics and boards while you watch live schematic, board and 3D views.
author: slashmad

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable zip
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
